integrity: Self-contained proof for an autonomous ODE and an optional exact-arithmetic/numerical verifier. No authorship, external validation, or source-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires positive fear K and strictly greater infected than susceptible predator mortality, positive prey and nonzero predator total initially.
Critical equality concerns predator invasion at the predator-free equilibrium, not epidemic reproduction at a positive disease-free equilibrium.
Finite-time experiments do not establish infinite-time limits; those rest on the proof.
Unindexed equivalent analyses and earlier unobserved preprints cannot be excluded.
title: Global critical predator clearance with a fear-independent prey deficit
